name: Patricia Williams
title: Exercise Safety
bio: Patricia Williams is the byline used at Senior Strength for articles on exercise safety for older adults and starting or progressing a program around common health conditions. It is a pen name, not a physician; how articles are researched and checked is explained in our editorial standards.
